Name: (JA) Ball Collection
Author: 8bitcanvas
Description:
*This text was written using Google Translate.

This is a mod that adds replica furniture of the ball that appears in the famous game.

The currently supported balls and their recipes are as follows.
Monster Ball - 5 stones, 1 copper bar
Great Ball - 3 copper bars, 1 iron bar
Ultra Ball - 3 iron bars, 3 gold bars
Master Ball - 1 rainbow gem, 3 iridium Bars
Safari Ball - 20 wood, 10 fibers, 3 stones, 1 copper bar
Net Ball - 6 insect meat, 1 copper bar
Dive Ball - 3 clams, 1 copper bar
Nest Ball - 30 fibers, 1 copper bar
Repeat Ball - 1 topaz, 1 copper bar
Timer Ball - 3 coffee, 1 copper bar
Luxury Ball - 1 ruby, 3 gold bars
Premier Ball - 5 copper bars
Dusk Ball - 1 amethyst, 1 iron bar
Heal Ball - 2 energy drinks, 1 copper bar
Quick Ball - 3 energy bars, 1 copper bar
Dream Ball - 3 purple mushrooms, 1 gold bar
Level ball - 3 topaz, 1 gold bar
Lure balls - 2 rainbow shells, 1 iron bar
Moon Ball - 5 star fruits, 1 gold bar
Friend Ball - 1 rabbit foot, 1 copper bar
Love Ball - 5 strawberry, 3 copper bars
Heavy Ball - 3 iron bars, 1 iridium bar
Speed Ball - 3 batteries, 1 copper bar
Beast Ball - 1 diamond, 1 Iridium Bar

Recipes can be purchased from the dwarf.
It is for display purposes only and is not suitable for exchange for cash.
Currently only English and Japanese are supported.
